title: E-minus: append-only, refused edits
shows: E-minus runs the same practice games and retries as E but its manual is append-only: updates, votes, merges and refinement are refused ("append-only manual: rules cannot be changed"). The same game for E (appended below) updated rule_7 and rule_3.
why_interesting: The ablation shows what rule management buys: E-minus keeps adding rules (26 after 40 games, 8 of them hidden Unresolved Errors) while E rewrites and merges (16 after 35).

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When an object must be picked up and placed in a target: search all containers and surfaces first, open any closed containers, take the object, go to the target, open it if closed, and move the object there.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.example: Search drawers and dresser surfaces, open drawer 4 to find the cd, take it, go to safe 1, open safe 1, move the cd to safe 1.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rendered_for_agent: [Success Process] When an object must be picked up and placed in a target: search all containers and surfaces first, open any closed containers, take the object, go to the target, open it if closed, and move the object there. Example: Search drawers and dresser surfaces, open drawer 4 to find the cd, take it, go to safe 1, open safe 1, move the cd to safe 1.

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When attempting to go to a container, ensure you are currently positioned at that container before issuing the command.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.example: In the failed attempt, the agent repeatedly tried 'go to drawer 4' while standing at drawer 3, causing the command to fail. In the successful retry, the agent moved to drawer 4 before opening it.
